UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Synced assistant settings, custom wake word, privacy/battery preferences, and cross-device behavioral context.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

wakeWord.description: Custom wake word phrase (e.g., Hey Aura).

offlineVoicePreferred.description: Whether on-device offline speech recognition and local command routing are preferred.

autoReadReplies.description: Whether Aura Assist automatically reads replies and identifications aloud via TTS.

batteryMode.description: Power profile controlling wake-word polling duty cycle and memory budget.

ttsSpeechRate.description: Text-to-Speech speaking rate multiplier between 0.5 and 2.0.

lastDeviceName.description: Most recently synced phone or desktop device label.

recentTopics.description: Bounded list (max 10) of recent behavioral interest tags for contextual suggestions.

AssistantMessage.title: AssistantMessage
AssistantMessage.description: A single turn in the user's cross-device synced assistant timeline (voice, text, Circle-to-Identify vision, or offline command).

mode.description: Modality used to generate or capture this message.

locationContext.description: Optional coarse location context at the time of interaction.

visualTag.description: Optional identified object label from Circle-to-Identify.

TaskAutomation.title: TaskAutomation
TaskAutomation.description: A real-time task automation routine triggered by voice phrase or contextual suggestion.

triggerPhrase.description: Natural-language voice phrase that invokes this routine.

actionPayload.description: Target parameter (e.g., time, destination, WhatsApp template, search query).

contextHint.description: Optional behavioral/location trigger hint (e.g., Morning Commute, At Work).

runCount.description: Number of times this routine has been executed.

MessageDraft.title: MessageDraft
MessageDraft.description: A WhatsApp message draft or incoming message saved for hands-free read-aloud and cross-device sync.

recipientPhone.description: Optional phone number with country code for direct WhatsApp deep-link.

body.description: Drafted WhatsApp message or received message text.

tone.description: Selected tone for AI message drafting.

direction.description: Whether this entry is an outgoing WhatsApp draft or an incoming message to read aloud.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the draft or incoming message.

TodoReminder.title: TodoReminder
TodoReminder.description: Synced to-do item, reminder, or calendar follow-up.

dueLabel.description: Optional due date or time label.

SmartHomeDevice.title: SmartHomeDevice
SmartHomeDevice.description: Synced smart home device state (lights, locks, thermostats, vacuums, TVs).

level.description: Brightness percentage, temperature in Celsius, or volume.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user's assistant preferences, wake word, and cross-device sync state.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{messageId.description: User-scoped timeline of voice, text, offline, and Circle-to-Identify assistant interactions.

/users/{userId}/automations/{automationI.description: User-scoped task automation routines synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/message_drafts/{draftId}.description: User-scoped WhatsApp drafts and hands-free message reader items.

/users/{userId}/todos/{todoId}.description: User-scoped synced to-do lists and reminders.

/users/{userId}/smart_devices/{deviceId}.description: User-scoped smart home devices and scene states.
